name: Sai Vishram Beach Resort
why_special: Beach-front resort on Chivla beach — 30 rooms, outdoor pool, Malvani thali restaurant. The senior private-resort pick in Malvan town with the strongest beach-walkout to Sindhudurg fort viewpoint.

name: Malvan Beach Resort (MTDC)
why_special: Maharashtra Tourism's smaller Malvan property — basic A/C and non-A/C rooms steps from the boat jetty to Sindhudurg fort. The official-rate pilgrim/fort-visitor pick, smaller than Tarkarli sister property.
